title: Orion — autonomous incident response inside your guardrails
description: A light, spring-animated landing page for an enterprise AI operations platform. The hero is an incident console: drag the autonomy dial (Observe, Suggest, Safe actions, Autonomous) or change the host limit and the same 02:14 incident replays under that rule, with the stage rail, audit trail, time to resolve and people woken updating live. Runbook folders, a pinned governance story, a peelable postmortem, a 3D incident calendar and plan cards follow.
features: Autonomy dial with four detents: drag, the knob stretches with speed and snaps on a spring; keyboard arrows work
Same incident replays under each policy and host limit, with a different outcome and audit trail each time
Stage rail with a packet that springs between Detect, Diagnose, Plan, Act, Verify and Close
Runbook folders that peek open, plus a copyable CLI command
Scope card with capsule toggles, a pausable runbook, a two-person approval and a hash-chained audit trail
Postmortem draft you peel back to reveal the raw evidence
